description: Check whether a CVE is in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalogue — i.e. confirmed exploited in the wild, the strongest 'patch this now' signal. Returns the vendor/product, when it was added, the remediation due date, and whether it's used in known ransomware campaigns. Interprets the CVE IDs host_exposure surfaces. Keyless, read-only.
name: kev_check
